#cloud-config

users:
  - name: appuser
    sudo: ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL
    home: /home/appuser
    shell: /bin/bash
    ssh_authorized_keys:
      - ssh-rsa  ubuntu@arnab-a4-client-vm

apt_update: true
apt_upgrade: true
packages:
 - python3-pip
 - python3-dev
 - build-essential

byobu_default: system 

runcmd:
 - pip3 install ray[tune] scikit-learn
